title: FIEZEL 30-Day Guided Roadmap to PTE Academic 42
description: Structured 30-day preparation program engineered for Fitra Rusdiawan targeting PTE Academic 42 (Vocational Benchmark / Australian Student Visa Subclass 500 for AILFE Perth). Based on the official 7-hour Nakul masterclass blueprint.

weeks.name: Week 1: Acoustic Foundations & Describe Image Mastery
weeks.focus: Read Aloud steady pitch (135–145 Hz), 5-line Describe Image template, and 25–28s stopping zone.

weeks.name: Week 2: Listening & Writing Dual-Scoring Core
weeks.focus: Repeat Sentence 50% rule, Write From Dictation prediction bank, and Extra Words hack.

weeks.name: Week 3: Reading Collocations & Single-Sentence SWT
weeks.focus: SWT 1-sentence compound rule, SST 50–70 word short connectors, and collocations.

weeks.name: Week 4: Timed Mini-Mocks & Exam Simulation
weeks.focus: Rapid-fire Big 4 speed runs, background acoustic tolerance, and readiness verification.

days.title: Day 1: Acoustic Foundation & Describe Image Template
days.focus: Read Aloud natural pitch and Describe Image 5-line template drill
days.nakulSecret: Men voice pitch must stay above 130 Hz (ideally 135–145 Hz). Speak naturally to a friend, do not force deep chest bass.
days.successMilestone: Complete all 5 daily tasks with >= 40 estimated Pearson score

tasks.title: 5 Read Aloud Passages
tasks.instructions: Read smoothly in 12–14s. Maintain pitch at 135–145 Hz. Zero self-correction.

tasks.title: 10 Repeat Sentence Drills
tasks.instructions: Aim for >=50% of words with smooth oral flow. Do not hesitate or say uh/um.

tasks.title: 3 Describe Image Template Drills
tasks.instructions: Follow Nakul 5-line template. Stop speaking inside the 25–28s green zone.

tasks.title: 10 Write From Dictation Drills
tasks.instructions: Apply Extra Words Hack for doubtful plurals or tenses. Ensure initial capital and final period.

tasks.title: 10-Min Kawan Bicara AI Coach Call
tasks.instructions: Voice simulation with AI Coach in Voice Studio. Practice conversational fluency and acoustic confidence.
